Unsere Mission ist es, ambitionierte Visionen zu verwirklichen, nachhaltiges Wachstum zu fördern und neue Chancen im europäischen Software-Ökosystem zu erschließen.

Die Unternehmen im Everfield-Ökosystem bewahren ihre Teams, Marken und Standorte, um sich gezielt auf ihre Kernkompetenzen zu konzentrieren: die Entwicklung innovativer Produkte und die umfassende Betreuung ihrer Kunden. Everfield bietet dabei gezielte Unterstützung in den Bereichen Personalgewinnung und HR sowie Zugang zu einem Expertenteam, das auf den Aufbau und das Wachstum europäischer B2B-SaaS-Unternehmen spezialisiert ist und in finanziellen sowie operativen Belangen berät. Seit der Gründung im Jahr 2022 ist Everfield in 7 Ländern präsent – und wächst stetig weiter.

Über helloTESS!

Cloudbasiert, flexibel und intuitiv – helloTESS! erfüllt die Anforderungen sowohl der klassischen Gastronomie als auch der Betriebsgastronomie und Hotellerie. Mit unserer cloudbasierten Lösung digitalisieren wir Bestell- und Bezahlprozesse, schaffen maximale Flexibilität und ermöglichen individuelle Erweiterungen, die sich an die Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden anpassen. So machen wir Gastronomie smarter, effizienter und zukunftssicher.

helloTESS! gehört seit 2024 zu Everfield. Der Hauptsitz von helloTESS! befindet sich in München.

Die TESSERO GmbH entwickelt mit helloTESS! moderne iPad- und Cloud-Lösungen für Gastronomie, Hotellerie und Gemeinschaftsverpflegung. Zur weiteren Stärkung unseres Vertriebs suchen wir für den Bereich General Business Nord einen engagierten Account Manager, der vollständig remote arbeitet, idealerweise in NRW lebt und unser Vertriebsgebiet in Norddeutschland inklusive NRW aufbaut und betreut.

Build and lead a practical, high-trust health and safety program for Mistral AI’s rapidly expanding data center operations. Your remit spans live sites, deployment projects, commissioning and transitions into operations. You will ensure that safety responsibilities are clearly defined and that Mistral-controlled activities meet applicable requirements while challenging partner performance where shared interfaces create risk.

  • Lead regular risk assessments, inspections and assurance reviews; prioritize findings by severity and exposure, assign owners and verify corrective actions have actually reduced risk.

  • Create consistent arrangements for site access, inductions, competency checks, contractor onboarding, safety briefings and refresher training, including evidence of completion.

The mission

You will work every day on the racks that power one of France's largest AI clusters.

Mistral's compute footprint is our single largest investment and the foundation of our AI research and engineering. We're hiring Data Center Hardware Engineers to keep our GPU/CPU clusters healthy, safe and growing — hands-on, in the data center, at the intersection of high-performance computing and physical infrastructure.

You'll join a small, senior team working at a scale few engineers get to experience: GPU-dense racks (H100/H200-class and next-generation platforms), high-speed interconnects, liquid-cooled systems — with new sites under development in France and beyond.

Hardware here is not someone else's problem. As part of a small on-site team, you carry responsibility for it end to end.

Location: On-site at one of our data center in Bessé-sur-Braye, Pays de la Loire.

  • Diagnose & repair server and cluster hardware: CPUs, memory, drives, NICs, GPUs, PSUs, and interconnect problems (switches, cables, transceivers; Ethernet/InfiniBand).

  • Intervene safely — power-off/lockout, ESD discipline, pre/post-work checklists, tidy and safe work areas.

  • Capture everything — photos, serials, test results; open, update and close tickets with notes the next engineer can act on.

  • Manage parts — receive, label and track inventory; run RMAs and coordinate with vendors.

title: Technical Product Lead - AI Stockbroking
description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

BJAK is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

 

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

 

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction

title: Engineering Manager (w/m/d) Robotics Tooling
description:
Deine Aufgaben

Du arbeitest in einem Team, das das gesamte Tooling-Ökosystem verantwortet, mit dem unsere Jungheinrich Robotics Lösungen über ihren gesamten Lebenszyklus hinweg implementiert, betrieben, unterstützt und kontinuierlich verbessert werden. Von der Inbetriebnahme eines Fahrzeugs vor Ort bis hin zur Ferndiagnose von Problemen einer gesamten Flotte stellst du gemeinsam mit deinem Team sicher, dass unsere Robotiksysteme über alle Robotikprodukte und zukünftigen Fahrzeuggenerationen hinweg effizient und skalierbar ausgeliefert, betrieben und unterstützt werden können.

Du arbeitest dabei in drei zentralen Bereichen:

  • Du entwickelst unser Onsite Tooling weiter und ermöglichst damit eine effiziente Implementierung, Inbetriebnahme und Durchführung von Serviceaktivitäten über unser HMI und unseren Environment Editor.
  • Du entwickelst unser Remote Tooling als Teil unserer Robotics Cloud weiter und ermöglichst damit Diagnose, Flottenmanagement, Monitoring und Support aus der Ferne.
  • Du gestaltest unsere Remote-Access-Lösungen und stellst einen sicheren und skalierbaren Zugriff auf unsere Robotiksysteme sicher, wann immer dieser erforderlich ist.

Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Product Manager für Robotics Tooling zusammen. Während der Product Manager den Fokus stärker auf das Was und Warum legt, ergänzt du diese Perspektive um das Wie und Wann.

  • Du verantwortest die technische Ausrichtung unseres Toolings, das eine schnelle Implementierung, effiziente Serviceprozesse, den Flottenbetrieb, Ferndiagnosen und eine hohe Systemverfügbarkeit ermöglicht
  • Du gestaltest ein skalierbares Tooling-Ökosystem, das über verschiedene Roboterfamilien, Kundeninstallationen und Supportorganisationen hinweg eingesetzt werden kann
  • Du führst und entwickelst ein Team aus internen und externen Software Engineers und schaffst ein Umfeld, in dem sich Mitarbeitende weiterentwickeln, erfolgreich arbeiten und wirkungsvolle Lösungen liefern können
  • Du definierst, steuerst und verfolgst gemeinsam mit dem Product Manager die vereinbarte Roadmap und stellst deren erfolgreiche Umsetzung sicher
  • Du baust starke Partnerschaften mit Product Management, Vehicle Engineering, Service, Operations und IT auf, um ein integriertes Tooling-Ökosystem zu realisieren
  • Du verbesserst kontinuierlich die User Experience für Inbetriebnahme- und Servicetechniker:innen, Supportteams und unsere Kunden
  • Du gestaltest die Strategie und Umsetzung sicherer Remote-Access-Lösungen und bringst dabei betriebliche Effizienz, Sicherheitsanforderungen und Kundenbedürfnisse in Einklang
  • Du förderst die Weiterentwicklung und Leistungsfähigkeit deines Teams durch Engagement, Coaching, individuelle Entwicklung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung
  • Du treibst Engineering Excellence durch agile Arbeitsweisen, qualitativ hochwertige Softwareentwicklung und moderne Engineering-Standard

We're looking for highly experienced software engineer (SR+) to help evaluate the quality of interactions with modern coding agents such as OpenAI Codex and Claude Code.

This is not a traditional engineering role. You won't be writing production code. You'll be evaluating something harder: whether the model thinks like a great engineer.

What this role actually is

You will assess how AI coding agents behave in real-world scenarios, focusing on:

• Whether the response makes sense

• Whether the preamble and reasoning are useful

• Whether the output reflects strong engineering judgment

• Whether the interaction feels right to an experienced developer

This role is about engineering taste. Syntax correctness is the easy part.

What you'll be doing

• Evaluate AI-generated coding interactions end to end

• Judge whether outputs are useful, correct at a high level, and aligned with how a strong engineer would think

• Assess the quality of explanations and reasoning, not just the code

• Distinguish between levels of response quality (what makes something a 2 vs a 4)

• Give clear, opinionated feedback in writing on what worked, what didn't, and what felt off or misleading

• Help define what great looks like when working with tools like Cursor, Codex and Claude Code

What we mean by "taste"

• Is this explanation helpful, or just technically correct?

Today, 25k Alan members open Alan Play every day (120,000 every month) to walk, meditate, breathe, compete with their colleagues, build healthy habits.   • Own the engineering performance and progression approach.

description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Analytical Chemistry Specialist – Freelance AI Trainer Project based in Netherlands.

Are you an analytical chemistry expert interested in contributing to the next generation of artificial intelligence? This freelance opportunity allows you to apply your scientific expertise to train and evaluate advanced AI models designed to support scientific discovery, education, and laboratory research. You will assess AI-generated responses to complex analytical chemistry questions, identify inaccuracies, and strengthen scientific reasoning across a wide range of applications. Your work will help improve the accuracy, reliability, and practical relevance of AI-generated scientific knowledge. Working remotely and independently, you will contribute specialized insights to the development of more capable and trustworthy AI systems. This role is ideal for experienced chemistry professionals who enjoy solving complex problems, communicating scientific concepts, and exploring the intersection of chemistry and emerging technology.


Accountabilities
  • Evaluate AI-generated scientific content: Review responses to theoretical and practical analytical chemistry questions, assessing their factual accuracy, logical consistency, scientific rigor, and relevance to real-world laboratory applications.
  • Apply specialized analytical chemistry knowledge: Develop and evaluate scenarios involving spectroscopy, chromatography, electrochemical analysis, quantitative chemical analysis, environmental testing, pharmaceutical analysis, and analytical method development.
  • Assess advanced analytical techniques: Challenge AI models on mass spectrometry, high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC), gas chromatography (GC), nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) interpretation, trace analysis, titrimetric methods, and related instrumentation.
  • Identify and document model weaknesses: Record reproducible errors, reasoning gaps, inaccurate interpretations, and other failure patterns to support systematic improvements in model performance.
  • Contribute to AI training and evaluation: Provide detailed scientific feedback, propose corrections, and recommend improvements to prompts, evaluation criteria, and testing methodologies.
  • Support scientific quality assurance: Apply principles of method validation, quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC), and analytical data interpretation to evaluate the reliability of AI-generated outputs.
  • Communicate scientific reasoning clearly: Explain conclusions, demonstrate analytical approaches, and document the steps behind technical judgments to help improve model transparency and reliability.

Your Arabic language expertise and cultural understanding will help make AI-generated content more natural, reliable, and representative of diverse communities.

  • Identifying errors, inconsistencies, and potentially misleading or unsuitable content in AI outputs.

  • Applying project-specific guidelines and quality standards while maintaining consistency and attention to detail.

Full-time | Permanent

At inspiring vet care, our people are at the heart of everything we do. As the UK’s number one vet care provider, we're trusted with the care of over 2 million animals, delivering our purpose of healthier animals and happier owners.

 

As part of Central Functions, you will be part of the teams that support and enable our network of over 2,500 practices across 20 countries, driving operational excellence, innovation and strategic impact across the business.

 

Whether your expertise is in Finance, HR, Technology, Marketing, Data, Legal, Operations or another specialist area, your work will help support colleagues and practices to deliver outstanding care to animals and their owners.

Lead the Future of Veterinary Clinical Research

At inspiring vet care, we're committed to advancing veterinary medicine through innovation, collaboration and evidence-based care. We're looking for an experienced Group Clinical Trials Manager to play a pivotal role in developing and delivering sponsored clinical trials across our international network of veterinary practices.

This is a unique opportunity to help shape and grow a clinical trials function within one of the world's leading veterinary groups. title: Data Scientist

Our mission

We're making Africa the first cashless continent.

In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

title: Senior Payroll and Benefits Specialist
description:
UFORCE exists to make aggression unaffordable.

Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia.

UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter-UAS systems.

About the Role

We're hiring a Senior Payroll and Benefits Specialist to own payroll processing and compliance for our workforce across the US and Europe. You will be the main contact between the company and our US EOR provider and international payroll advisors (UK, US, Poland, Portugal, Estonia, Germany). For European entities that run payroll locally, you will receive their payroll data, keep one accurate record of who sits on which entity's books, and consolidate it into group-level reporting. You will also own benefits administration, the annual renewal cycle, and pensions in every country where we operate.

The job covers more than processing. You will run live payroll cycles accurately and also improve how payroll works: writing SOPs, tightening controls, consolidating reporting, managing providers, and supporting audits. Over time you will reduce our reliance on third-party providers by moving payroll onto our in-house platform in each country where we hold a local entity, including setting up payroll for a separate US entity on its own system ahead of a planned handover to local ownership. You will work closely with People, Finance, payroll providers, benefits brokers, pension providers, and auditors, and you will be the person employees go to for fast, accurate answers on pay, pension, and benefits. The role is UK-based.

Responsibilities

  • Run UK and US payroll cycles from start to finish: validate all inputs (new hires, leavers, salary changes, bonuses, commissions, time off), review every payroll register, and coordinate with the US EOR and international payroll advisors.

  • Act as the main contact for European entities that run their own payroll: receive monthly payroll data, reconcile it against HRIS headcount, and keep a single accurate record of who sits on which entity's books.

  • Own statutory filings and tax portal access for UK and US payroll, and produce consolidated group payroll reporting to support month-end close, accruals, reconciliations, and audit.

title: Senior ML Engineer
description:
Who we are

Yubo is the Social Discovery app to make new friends and hang out online. By eliminating likes and follows, we empower our users to create genuine connections and show up as their true selves.

We've pioneered a new way for Gen Z to socialize online, and with millions of active users, our goal is to redefine how we connect today and tomorrow.

Our team is international, multicultural and deeply committed to its mission. As the leading platform to socialize online, we have a special responsibility to build a safe digital space for our community. Safety is embedded in our DNA, and our proactive approach focuses on user protection, support, and education.

Join us in this exciting journey and help us shape the future of social interactions!

About this role

As Yubo continues to scale, Machine Learning is becoming a core production layer, powering critical systems across safety, recommendations, and product optimization.

What makes this role unique is both the scale and diversity of our data, and the level of maturity we are aiming to reach.

We process massive volumes of images, text, and real-time user interactions, across millions of users worldwide, creating a wide range of high-impact ML challenges, including:

  • Content moderation (image, text, behavior)

  • Recommendation systems and user engagement optimization

  • Behavioral detection and trust & safety models

  • Emerging use cases such as dynamic pricing and growth optimization

At the same time, our current ML stack is still evolving.
Legacy models are not fully integrated into pipelines, lifecycle management remains inconsistent, and our approach can sometimes resemble “develop, deploy, and forget.”

As ML usage expands across the company, this creates increasing complexity and dependency on reliable, well-structured systems.

There is still a huge amount of untapped potential, with many ML use cases yet to be designed, tested, and scaled, but unlocking it requires building a more robust and scalable ML operating model.

We are therefore looking for a Senior ML Engineer to join our Platform Engineering team, reporting directly to Mikael (Head of Platform Engineering).

title: Manager Robotic Sales Engineering
description:
About the Role at RobCo

RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works.

 

At RobCo, we automate the ordinary, so humans can do the extraordinary. To achieve this, we are looking for an ambitious Manager Robotic Sales Engineering (m/f/d) to help us establish RobCo as leading provider of automation solutions.

Your mission

Robotic Sales Engineers (RSEs) are RobCo’s technical face to the customer. They qualify opportunities, run requirement workshops, check feasibility and drive each deal to a concept our Solutions Development team can build.

As Manager Robotic Sales Engineering, you lead a team of around six RSEs and report to the Head of Robotic Sales Engineering. You make sure every deal gets the right technical lead, every customer gets a consistent experience and every RSE on your team keeps getting better. You carry a quota together with Sales and are measured on whether your team hits it.

You are a player-coach. You lead the team, and you still go on-site for the deals that matter most. You work where modular robotics, software and AI come together, and you help scale how RobCo brings physical AI into real production.

What you will do

  • Lead and grow the team – Hire, onboard and coach your RSEs. Run regular 1:1s, give clear feedback, write performance reviews and build real career paths.

  • Deliver the quota – Own your team’s quota together with your Sales counterparts. Track pipeline and win rates, spot deals at risk early and put your team’s capacity where it moves the number.

  • Steer the deal portfolio – Match RSEs to Account Executives and deals, balance workload and set priorities together with Sales and Delivery, so no customer waits and no deal slips.

  • Raise the quality bar – Set the standard for discovery, requirement workshops, feasibility checks and handovers. Review the critical concepts before they go to the customer or to Solutions Development.

  • Be hands-on where it counts – Join strategic accounts and complex workshops yourself, and be the technical escalation point for customers and AEs.

title: Senior Medical Writer | France
description:

The medical writer may produce protocols, publications, study reports, investigator brochures, narratives, and module documents, according to client and agency guidelines, to support drug development under brisk timelines. 

Responsibilities:

  • Coordinate cross-functional client contributors and stakeholders as well as internal resources (e.g., quality control [QC], publishing) to ensure timely completion of documents 

  • Ensure document development adheres to any relevant client processes, templates, and instructional documents 

  • Serve as an expert on client document management system and related tools, templates, and procedures to ensure efficient document development  

  • Lead document message development in collaboration with client  

  • Interpret data and create shell documents to support authoring 

  • Plan and lead kickoff meetings  

  • Facilitate resolution of review feedback including planning and leading comment resolution meetings (curate review comments to ensure meetings are efficient)  

  • Follow-up with individual team members as needed to resolve outstanding review feedback 

  • Ensure consistency among client programs in terms of messaging, formatting, and presentation of documents  

  • Conduct literature searches as needed 

  • Perform peer QC review as needed  

  • Contribute to medical writing operational initiatives (e.g., templates, style guides, reference management), if needed 


  • Experience (5+ years) as a medical writer in the CRO/biotech/pharmaceutical field

title: Content Creator:in (Werkstudent:in / Praktikum) – Hochzeit & Social Media, Hybrid/Remote
description:
Wer wir sind

Weddybird begleitet Paare vom ersten „Wir heiraten!“ bis weit über den großen Tag hinaus. Hochzeitswebsite, Gästeliste, Save-the-Date, Fotogalerie: alles an einem Ort. Damit die Vorfreude wächst, nicht das Chaos.

Weddybird ist ein kleines, inhabergeführtes Technologie-Unternehmen. In unserem kompakten Team arbeiten wir remote und eng zusammen, ohne starre Vorgaben oder unzählige Meetings.

Jetzt suchen wir jemanden, der genau das vor der Kamera rüberbringt.

Was du bei uns machst

  • Du drehst kurze Videos für Instagram Reels und TikTok: Talking Head, Yapping, „Meine Tipps für …“

  • Du entwickelst Ideen auf Basis unserer Briefings und unseres Redaktionsplans

  • Du schneidest deine Videos selbst, mit Untertiteln und starken Hooks

  • Du stimmst dich regelmäßig mit unserem Social-Media-Team ab

  • Du hast Trends im Blick und bringst eigene Formatideen ein

Was du mitbringst

  • Du stehst gern vor der Kamera und redest so, wie du mit deiner besten Freundin redest

  • Du kennst Reels und TikTok nicht nur als Zuschauer:in, sondern hast schon selbst Content erstellt

  • Du schneidest sicher mit CapCut, Edits oder deinem favorisiertem Tool

  • Du arbeitest selbstständig und hältst Absprachen ein

  • Du bist eingeschrieben (Werkstudent:in) oder suchst ein Pflichtpraktikum, das deine Hochschule mit ca. 10 Std./Woche über 6 Monate anerkennt

  • Ein Smartphone mit guter Kamera hast du sowieso

  • Bonus: Du interessierst dich für Hochzeiten.

Was wir dir bieten

  • Flexible Zeiteinteilung, auch rund um Prüfungsphasen

  • Flexible Remote-Arbeit mit gelegentlichen Team-Meetings in Hamburg

  • Echte Verantwortung: Deine Videos gehen live, du siehst direkt, was funktioniert

  • Feste Ansprechpartnerin und klares Feedback statt endloser Korrekturschleifen

  • Ein Portfolio, das sich sehen lassen kann

So bewirbst du dich

Wir brauchen kein formelles Anschreiben. Wir möchten den Menschen hinter der Bewerbung kennen lernen. Du darfst selber entscheiden, wie du dich am besten präsentierst. Schick uns stattdessen gerne ein kurzes Video (30–60 Sekunden) zu dir oder beispielhaft zu einem der folgenden Themen: „Dein Tipp für ein entspanntes Save-the-Date“ oder „Deine 3 Must-haves auf einer Hochzeit“

Dazu: Lebenslauf und gern Links zu deinem bisherigen Content. Bitte gib an, ob du dich als Werkstudent:in oder für ein Pflichtpraktikum bewirbst.

Wir freuen uns auf dich.

Vergütung

Die Vergütung für diese Position liegt bei EUR 14–18 pro Stunde.

title: Palantir Foundry Engineer (Relocation to Abu Dhabi, UAE)
description:
Who We Are

Founded in 2017, Unit8 is a Swiss data and AI consulting company helping organisations in traditional industries solve complex challenges in areas such as operations, finance, manufacturing and R&D. We work at the intersection of technology and business, delivering data and AI solutions that create practical value for our clients.

Our teams have delivered projects across industries including automotive, chemicals, financial services, manufacturing and pharma. We are a Palantir partner and work with clients across the full data and AI journey, from understanding a business problem to building and deploying the solution.

Unit8 has delivered more than 300 projects and grown to a team of 190+ talented people across ten office locations. Following our growth across Europe and our expansion into North America, we are now building our presence in the United Arab Emirates. We are looking for a Palantir Foundry Engineer to join us in Abu Dhabi. This role is based in the UAE and includes relocation from Switzerland with full immigration and relocation support.

Requirements

About the Role

As one of the first members of Unit8’s team in the UAE, you will help deliver Foundry solutions for clients while contributing to the growth of our presence in the region.

You will work directly with client teams to understand their data and operational challenges, then design and build solutions that address them. The role combines hands-on engineering with close collaboration across business and technical teams. You will also contribute your technical perspective during early client discussions and help shape practical approaches to new opportunities.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, deploy and maintain data solutions using Palantir Foundry.
  • Develop and troubleshoot data pipelines and processing systems using Foundry and relevant open-source or proprietary technologies.
  • Build and maintain Foundry components such as Ontologies, pipelines, and user-facing applications.
  • Apply sound engineering practices for testing, data quality, performance, security and maintainability.
  • Work with client stakeholders to understand requirements, clarify problems and translate business needs into technical solutions.
  • Collaborate with engineers, data scientists, product owners and client teams in an agile environment.
  • Contribute to technical discovery and solution scoping for prospective and ongoing engagements.
  • Help establish Unit8’s engineering and delivery approach in the UAE, sharing knowledge with colleagues and supporting the growth of the local team.

About You

title: Lead Java Developer/Solution Architect (6-month contract)
description:
gravity9 is recruiting Java engineers and architects for a portfolio of engagements across UK central government. These are large-scale, data-intensive modernisation programmes: replacing legacy systems that carry statutory weight, decomposing monoliths that serve millions of users, and building secure data platforms where access control and auditability are first-class architectural concerns rather than late additions.

We are hiring across two overlapping profiles — Senior Java Developer and Application / Migration Architect — and expect most people to move between programmes as engagements start and complete. Several of these are hands-on architect roles: you will own design decisions and also write production code

The kind of work

The following are representative of current and upcoming engagements. Individual roles will draw on some of this, not all of it — we are more interested in engineers who can work confidently at the intersection of Java and data than in a checklist match against any one programme.

Secure data catalogue and access-control platform

A greenfield metadata catalogue acting as a federated index over data held across independent domains, so that authorised parties can locate and retrieve data the catalogue itself never holds. The work includes designing an attribute-based access control model over attributes such as clearance, nationality, organisational unit and compartment; enforcing those policies inside the database query path rather than filtering results afterwards; application-layer encryption with externally managed keys; hybrid lexical and semantic search with access filtering applied before candidate retrieval rather than after it; and a tamper-evident audit trail that can reconstruct why a given record was returned, redacted or withheld.

Real-time decision-support data architecture

Replacing point-to-point integration across a multi-vendor estate with a microservices architecture and a common data layer, so that operational data flows in near real time instead of over days. The work includes target-state architecture and decision records, change-data-capture ingest pipelines from upstream data services, ontology and mapping-layer design across suppliers with competing data models, separation of system, reference and insight data classes including time-series, and deployment topologies spanning cloud-hosted services down to constrained edge hardware.

Legacy-to-document-model migration at national scale

Migrating hundreds of millions of records and tens of terabytes of XML out of a legacy relational platform into a sharded document store, in support of a COBOL-to-Java microservices rewrite. title: Research Engineer, GPU Performance
description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

About the Role

As a Research Engineer, GPU performance, you will sit at the heart of that spectrum: your low-level work directly determines how fast our frontier models can be trained and served. Working hand-in-hand with Research Scientists, you'll make every GPU count.

Mistral AI is hiring an expert in pushing large language model's GPU utilization and performance to their limits.. In this role, you will own the performance of our models end-to-end: writing the low-level code that extracts the maximum capacity from high-end hardware, and rethinking model architectures so they run efficiently at scale.

What You Will Do

  • Develop low-level code that takes full advantage of high-end GPUs and maxes out their capacity — from custom kernels to memory-layout and communication optimisations.

  • Rethink parts of the generative model architecture to make them more suitable for efficient inference, in collaboration with Research Scientists.

  • Integrate low-level efficient code into a high-level MLOps framework, so that optimisations benefit every training run and deployment rather than a single experiment.

  • Profile, benchmark and squeeze performance out of large-scale training and inference on thousands of GPUs.

  • Model LLM execution on various GPUs with high fidelity to assess hardware usage and build serving performance estimates.

What We're Looking For

  • High technical competence for writing custom low-level kernels and pushing GPUs to their limits.

  • High expertise in the distributed computation infrastructure of current-generation GPU clusters.

title: Director, Luxury Market Intelligence & Insights
description:
We are growing! We are currently looking to hire a Director, Luxury Market Intelligence & Insights.  

About CXG:

Founded in 2006, CXG is a global customer experience company uniquely positioned at the intersection of data-driven retail performance, customer experience transformation, and operational execution across 200+ luxury brands worldwide.

The mission of our 270 collaborators is to help brands transform customer and employee experiences through tailored insights, strategy, and implementation.

We are passionate about delivering impact.

We are looking for a thought leadership expert with the editorial vision to spot what matters next, the conviction to shape CXG's point of view, and the writing talent to make it influential across luxury retail, beauty and cosmetics, watches and jewellery, automotive, and hospitality.

Context and role

This is a hands-on role: you will research, analyse, write and produce content yourself, while mobilising expertise and data from across the business. You will be accountable for ensuring that every publication presents a recognisable CXG angle rather than simply reporting market developments or repeating established industry views. title: Senior AI Researcher: LLM post-training for hallucination reduction (f/m/d)
description:
Who we are

Aleph Alpha’s mission is to deliver sovereign, human-centric AI to governmental institutions and large enterprises. To that end, we deliver category-defining AI innovation that enables open, accessible, and trustworthy deployment of GenAI in industrial applications. Our organization develops foundational models and next-generation methods that make it easy and affordable for Aleph Alpha’s customers to increase productivity in development, engineering, logistics, and manufacturing processes.

About the role

We are looking for a (Senior) AI Researcher to join our hallucination reduction capability team to push the boundaries in LLM post-training (SFT and RL).

We're one of the few places in Europe training foundation models from scratch. You will be part of a team of (senior) researchers and PhD interns doing cutting-edge research across pre-, mid- and post-training, grounding and specialized models with hundreds of GPUs at our disposal.

What will you do

  • Core Research & Development: Design, execute, and scale post-training methodologies (SFT, RL) specifically aimed at eliminating model hallucinations and making them grounded in evidence.

  • Uncertainty & Reliability: Research and implement techniques in uncertainty estimation, calibration, self-consistency, and self-correction mechanisms to enable models to identify and signal when they “don't know”.

  • Post-Training Pipelines: Build and optimize high-throughput, distributed fine-tuning and training pipelines across multi-node GPU clusters.

  • Evaluation & Benchmarking: Design and implement rigorous evaluation methods to benchmark hallucination rates, truthfulness, and reasoning accuracy.

  • Technical Ownership: Drive research projects independently from initial hypothesis to scalable production implementation and technical reports.

Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience fine-tuning or post-training LLMs using modern distributed training frameworks.

  • Track record of research or implementation in at least one of the following domains:

    • Hallucination mitigation / truthfulness alignment / grounding in RAG

    • Uncertainty estimation, or out-of-distribution detection

title: Enterprise Account Executive
description:
About Kernel

Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this?

 

Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier.

 

Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust.

 

Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent KERN ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Checkout already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them.

 

We have raised $14M from top VCs and operators at Plaid, OpenAI, Slack and others, and we are growing 5x YoY.

The Role:

  • We are looking for Enterprise Account Executives.

  • This role is focused on selling into global enterprises with distributed teams, multiple buying centres, layered governance, and high data sensitivity. These are strategic accounts where the impact of accurate hierarchies and clean CRM data is measured in millions.

  • Our first ramped AEs are far exceeding quota, so we know the motion works.

  • Our early enterprise motion is working. We are generating strong demand and building pipeline within large organisations.

  • You will be responsible for driving high six-figure opportunities and are confident that we will close the first 7 figure deals this year through complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.

  • Our targets call for millions of additional ARR over the next year. You will play a major role in that.

title: Project Leider Bouw
description:
Monumental automatiseert de bouw met robotica en software. Onze missie is om de bouw software-defined en autonoom te maken – een toekomst waarin mooie gebouwen op maat in één dag verrijzen, met minimale inzet van handwerk.

We zijn een groeiend team van engineers, operators en technici, afkomstig van bedrijven als Palantir, Qualcomm, Dyson, Shopify, Tesla, Meta en Google DeepMind. We staan nog aan het begin van het opbouwen van dit bedrijf, en dit is je kans om buitenproportioneel veel impact te maken op een probleem dat écht uitmaakt. Vanaf dag één werk je samen met een ervaren foundingteam, met een Series B van $32M achter ons onder leiding van Khosla Ventures en Plural.

Monumental zit in het centrum van Amsterdam, in een prachtig pand met een volledig uitgeruste werkplaats en een eigen testvloer voor robots. We bouwen de hele stack in-house – hardware én software. We zijn uitdrukkelijk geen hybride of remote-first bedrijf: robots en muren bouw je niet vanaf je keukentafel, dus we werken vijf dagen per week op locatie.

Lees meer over waarom wij vinden dat je je tijd aan de bouw zou moeten besteden, en over onze visie en ons bedrijf. Misschien vind je ons YouTube-kanaal interessant, de film van Based in Europe over hoe we het Europese woningtekort aanpakken, of deze video van Andreas Klinger over hoe ons kantoor eruitziet.

Over de functie

De afgelopen jaren is Monumental gegroeid van een werkend product en de eerste proefprojecten naar bouwen op grote schaal. Inmiddels hebben we een vloot van meer dan 150 robots, die metselwerk hebben uitgevoerd voor meer dan 90 woningen, een school, een buurthuis, een hotel en meer dan 150 meter kanaalwand.

Elke maand nemen we meer bouwprojecten aan, intern noemen we die ‘deployments’. We werken met meer robots en meer mensen en breiden vanuit Nederland uit naar het Verenigd Koninkrijk en de VS.

Als Hub Lead zet je onze eerste vestiging buiten het hoofdkantoor op, in het noorden van Nederland. Je begint met ons grootste bouwproject tot nu toe.

You care about the impact millions of people watching TV has on the environment. Well, congratulations, you've come to the right place and you’re already on your journey.

Founded in 2005 Zattoo is one of the leading TV streaming providers in Europe with around 3 million users per month. With headquarters in Zurich, we also have a large office in Berlin, and a team over in Ann Arbor, Michigan, in the USA. Over 200 employees contribute to the television of the future and yes, we are growing! We are pioneers in our field and wish to remain so in the years to come. That challenges us and is great fun.

We have a culture that is constantly on the lookout for new opportunities, allows mistakes to be made in learning and places good ideas above hierarchies. For us, flexible working hours and the opportunity to work remotely are a matter of course. We truly foster trust based working.

What is the Zattoo Talent Community?

The Zattoo Talent Community is the place where you can engage with us and let us know you would like to #jointhestreamteam but you can’t see an open position that suits you just yet. We’d love to hear from you and keep you in mind for future roles and we promise to keep in touch with you. All you have to do is two simple tasks:

  • Upload your current CV
  • Add a cover letter - this part is just as important as the CV. Let us know what kind of role you’re interested in.

And in the meantime remember to regularly check our careers page for new vacancies.

We regularly hire for:

  1. Technology - engineers, product designers, IT operations, QA, Data & Business Intelligence
  2. Commercial - Marketing & Communications and Sales & Business Development
  3. Customer - Customer Service, Implementation, Service Delivery, Project Management
  4. Central Operations - Finance, People, Workplace
  5. Students - working students position

Its offerings include the most energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers. title: ML Engineer (Computer Vision & ML Ops)
description:
StellDirVor is an independent consulting, trade and technology company specializing in immersive technologies for healthcare. We support organizations in implementing digital innovations — Virtual, Augmented and Mixed Reality as well as AI — particularly for learning, training and real-time assistance in clinical and care environments. By combining technology and healthcare, we help optimize processes, improve knowledge transfer and enhance quality of care.

Supported by a Germany (ZIM) and Taiwanese (GIPIP) partnership grant, we are currently developing ARAIAS — an AR- and AI-based hands-free training and assistance system for chronic wound care. Using AR smart glasses, the system enables 3D capture, AI-supported analysis, and standardized remote expertise and documentation directly at the point of care.

As our ML Engineer (Computer Vision & ML Ops), you will build the AI capabilities at the core of ARAIAS: evaluating and fine-tuning computer vision models on smart glasses data, running the ML operations behind them, and applying generative AI to create synthetic medical images for education. We're at an early stage — moving from concept to working prototype — so the near-term focus is on validating models and building toward a proof of concept we can test in real education and clinical settings.

As part of a small team, you will own the full data lifecycle end to end — from sourcing, consent and annotation to preparation — alongside model development and deployment.

We welcome candidates at different experience levels. What matters most is a solid ML foundation and genuine awareness of the medical imaging domain.

Notes:

Due to the nature of the project, we can only consider candidates who are already residing in Germany.

Tasks

  • Select and benchmark pre-trained models and/or validated architectures for medical image analysis and adapt them to domain-specific data, ensuring robust performance under real-world conditions

  • Identify and adapt suitable generative AI models to create realistic synthetic medical images for education and training

  • Evaluate and fine-tune small language models (SLMs) for voice interaction — speech-to-text, intent understanding and text-to-speech — optimized for low-latency or on-device use with smart glasses

title: CRM & Retention Manager (m/w/d) – Remote
description:
Über Löwenanteil

Unsere Mission ist es, allen Menschen eine ausgewogene und hochwertige Ernährung so leicht wie möglich zu machen. Unsere Bio-Gerichte sind proteinreich, aus besten Zutaten und verdammt lecker. Denn wir machen Essen wieder zu dem, was es sein sollte: einem Antrieb, der schmeckt!

Worum es geht

Bei uns ist Kundenkommunikation nicht nur Newsletter-Versand, sondern einer der wichtigsten Wachstumshebel im Unternehmen. Wir suchen eine Person, die die Kommunikation mit unseren Kunden – von Newsletter über WhatsApp bis zum Abo-Management – steuert und damit direkten Einfluss auf Retention und Customer Lifetime Value nimmt. Du verantwortest bei uns Ergebnisse und nicht lediglich To-dos.

Ein wichtiger Teil davon ist KI: Du nutzt sie ganz selbstverständlich in deinem Arbeitsalltag – um Probleme clever zu lösen, schneller voranzukommen und mehr zu bewegen. Du probierst gern Neues aus und teilst mit dem Team, was funktioniert.

Deine Aufgaben

  • CRM-Strategie & Ownership: Du verantwortest unsere CRM- und Retention-Strategie end-to-end, entwickelst daraus eine klare Roadmap und priorisierst eigenständig die größten Hebel für Wiederkaufrate, Retention und Customer Lifetime Value.

  • Newsletter & Kampagnen: Du entwickelst unsere Kampagnen- und Kommunikationsstrategie in Klaviyo weiter und steuerst Newsletter datenbasiert, segmentiert und entlang klarer Kunden- und Businessziele.

  • Lifecycle & Flow-Automation: Du entwickelst unsere Customer Lifecycle Kommunikation kontinuierlich weiter – von Welcome und Post-Purchase über Cross-/Upselling bis Replenishment, Subscription und Winback – und baust skalierbare Automationen statt manueller Einzellösungen.

  • WhatsApp & neue Kanäle: Du baust WhatsApp-Marketing als Kanal weiter aus, gestaltest die Auswahl passender Tools mit und erschließt neue CRM-Kanäle.

  • Subscription & Retention: Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit relevanten Stakeholdern unser Subscription-Modell weiter und verantwortest CRM-seitig die Steigerung von Abo-Conversion, Laufzeit und Retention.

  • Experimentation & Growth: Du entwickelst datenbasierte Hypothesen, priorisierst Experimente nach Impact und skalierst erfolgreiche Mechaniken.

  • Daten & Reporting: Du sorgst für saubere Daten zwischen Shop, CRM- und Messaging-Tools und steuerst über KPIs wie Wiederkaufrate, Churn, CLV und Umsatz pro Empfänger.

Das bringst du mit

Drei Dinge sind für diese Rolle die Basis: fundierte Erfahrung mit Klaviyo und Shopify sowie ein fortgeschrittener, souveräner Umgang mit KI.

  • Klaviyo: Du baust Segmente, Flows und Tests selbst und wertest sie aus

  • Shopify: Du arbeitest sicher mit Shopify und verstehst, wie Bestell-, Kunden- und Event-Date

title: Research Engineer - Search and Services
description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

Role Summary

We are seeking a talented and experienced Research Engineer to join our newly forming Search and Services Platform team within Research Platform. You will build and operate the large-scale search and services that our models rely on as tools — from self-hosted, web-scale, search indexes to knowledge graphs and databases served through MCP. You will work closely with researchers and with the pretraining data, sandbox and data platform teams to make these services reliable, scalable and fast, on infrastructure measured in hundreds of terabytes of NVMe storage and thousands of CPU cores to support both data generation and critical training runs.

What you will do

As a Research Engineer on the Search and Services team, your responsibilities will include (but may not be limited to):

  • Designing, building and operating large-scale search infrastructure: self-hosted Vespa clusters indexing web-scale corpora, managed indexes for smaller corpora, and vendor search endpoints.

  • Self-hosting and maintaining a wide range of structured data sources — knowledge graphs (Wikidata, UniProt, Materials Project), scholarly data (OpenAlex, OpenAIRE), statistical databases (Eurostat, World Bank, IMF, OECD), open data portals and more.

  • Designing interfaces and tools to expose to the models and agents to use the services in different ways (direct YQL or SPARQL queries, or more refined and constrained MCPs to mimic external services) to support data generation and agentic training.

  • Building the data pipelines that ingest, index and serve massive datasets, including indexing our own pretraining corpora for exploration, deduplication and eval-leakage checks.

This role provides a genuine opportunity to create a direct impact on the biggest occasions and moments in cricket; this could be operating the technology to correctly call an LBW decision during an England Test match at Lord's, or telling the story of the impactful bowling spell during the Cricket World Cup Final.

Our powerful hardware and software will allow your creativity to flourish, with ideas and innovation being the main tools behind our success. You will get the opportunity to work with passionate, innovative, motivated and intelligent people throughout the company, who will continually try to push your personal development and engage with your desired long-term career path.

Siena is the Agent of Record for CX, built for consumer brands like Spanx, FIGS, Brooklinen, and Grüns.

It runs as a connected multi-agent stack on top of a shared intelligence layer: agents that sell, support, listen, handle social and voice across the entire customer journey, turning every conversation into signal you can act on.

The team

We are a small, fully distributed, global team. We have built leverage into how we work, which is what lets a team this size move at the speed we do.

We hire athletes. Everyone here owns real outcomes, defaults to writing over meetings, communicates with directness, and acts the moment they see something worth acting on. Low ego, high standards, fast clock.

If you want to set the bar rather than follow one, keep reading.

The Role

You own the commercial relationship for Siena's highest-value brands: renewals, expansion, executive trust, and knowing your accounts better than anyone. A deployment strategist owns product outcomes for the same accounts, and together you're the Siena pod.

You're accountable for net dollar retention, expansion quota attainment, and executive relationship health across your book. You own our Growth and Strategic segment accounts, not the full customer book, working at the intersection of customer, sales, and your deployment strategist. Expect moderate travel for in-person workshops, account visits, and QBRs.

title: Product Safety & Certification Engineer - Fuel Cell Systems
description:
About EH Group Engineering

EHG is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product is a significantly more compact fuel cell with high power density and lower costs of production. Faced with the challenges of climate change and the transition to a decentralised energy system, EHG seeks to provide high performance and cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To help achieve our vision of a decarbonised future we are seeking a Functional Safety Engineer to embed safety into our fuel cell systems, leading hazard analysis and safety engineering across hardware, software and controls to ensure our products are safe, compliant and certifiable.

This role requires full-time, on-site presence at our Nyon, Switzerland office. We're not able to offer remote or hybrid arrangements, so candidates should be prepared to relocate.

 

Key Responsibilities:

• Own the functional safety lifecycle for fuel cell systems from concept to release

• Lead hazard and risk analyses (HARA, HAZOP, FMEA/FMEDA, FTA) and define safety goals

• Derive safety requirements and concepts and allocate them across hardware, software and controls

• Define/verify safety mechanisms, diagnostics and safe states with the controls and embedded teams

• Perform safety analyses and calculations (SIL/PL/ASIL determination, metrics, PFH/PFD)

• Compile safety cases, safety plans and supporting documentation for certification

• Interface with notified bodies, certification authorities and customers on safety topics

• Promote a strong safety culture and coach teams on functional safety practices

 

Skills and Experience Required:

• BSc/MSc in electrical, electronic, mechatronic, control or safety engineering is mandatory

• Minimum 3-5 years of functional safety experience in industrial, energy or hydrogen systems

• Working knowledge of safety standards (ex. IEC 61508, ISO 13849, ISO 26262 and/or IEC 62061)

• Hands-on experience with HARA, FMEA/FMEDA, FTA and safety requirements engineering

• Understanding of safety-related hardware, embedded software and control architectures

• Familiarity with hydrogen

title: Production Engineer
description:
Monumental is automating on-site construction with robotics and software. Our mission is to make construction software-defined and autonomous - a future where beautiful, bespoke buildings go up in a single day, with minimal labour.

We're a growing team of engineers, operators and technicians from companies like Palantir, Qualcomm, Dyson, Shopify, Tesla, Meta and Google DeepMind. It's still the early days of building the company, and this is a chance to make an outsized impact on a problem that matters. From day one, you’ll be working with an experienced founding team, backed by a $32M Series B led by Khosla Ventures and Plural.

Monumental is based in the city centre of Amsterdam, in a beautiful facility with an fully equipped workshop and robot testing floor. We build the whole stack in-house - hardware and software, we're explicitly not a hybrid or remote-first company - you can't build robots or walls from home, so we're onsite five days a week.

 

Read more on why we believe you should spend your time working on construction, and learn about our vision and company. You might enjoy Based in Europe’s film on how we’re fixing Europe’s housing shortage, or this video by Andreas Klinger of what our office looks like.

About the role

Monumental are already deploying robots into the real world at scale, building beautiful, bespoke homes. Our robots are on sites across the Netherlands and the UK and will be in the US within a year. Every deployment teaches us something about our hardware; you’ll push our R&D fleet to become one ready for large-series production: you'll own taking us from tens of robots a year to hundreds, and then thousands. You'll also keep that growing fleet deployable, and making design changes yourself to improve reliability and serviceability.

Scaling a fleet means solving whatever is in the way: limited space, no clear production process, lead times we can't live with and modules that don't survive the harsh conditions of a construction site. You’ll be expected to wear many hats; we’re looking for people who are genuinely excited to lead these efforts.

description:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

description:
About our client

Our client is an established software company in the field of IT security. For more than two decades, it has been developing solutions for secure digital communication – technology that reliably protects content and identities and keeps unwanted messages and malware at bay, without putting technical hurdles in the way of its users. Several thousand customers from regulated industries such as healthcare, energy, finance and insurance, public administration, pharmaceuticals and law rely on this technology.

The company is rooted in the German-speaking market and is currently growing internationally. Precision, reliability and high standards of quality shape its products just as much as the way people work together. Its core values – openness, reliability, appreciation and competence – apply within the team as much as in dealings with customers and partners.

We are happy to share our client’s name in a personal conversation.


Your mission

You will shape how several companies become one organisation.

Our client is growing – through acquisitions, through internationalisation and through building new structures across Switzerland, Germany, Denmark and further locations. This phase will not be decided by strategy, but by whether the people in our companies come along.

That is exactly what we need you for. As Director People & Culture, you will make sure the upcoming consolidation and integration steps are accepted and consistently implemented across the entire group: structures, roles, leadership, communication and the retention of the people we want to keep. You will report directly to our CEO and work closely with him.

The role is strategic and hands-on at the same time. There is no large HR apparatus behind you – you design the solution and then implement it yourself.


Your tasks and responsibilities

  • You develop the target picture of our organisation together with the CEO and the managing directors, and keep it moving forward
  • You integrate acquired companies from a people perspective: organisational structure, roles, leadership levels, compensation logic and culture
  • You build a group-wide role and job architecture and harmonise structures across borders – without overriding local realities
  • You enable our managers for phases of change, from structured performance conversations to the difficult ones
  • You own internal communication around change initiatives and advise the CEO on it
  • You develop and implement a retention strategy for key people
  • You prepare workforce adjustments and see them through in a legally sound way across all jurisdictions involved
  • You develop our HR processes and systems further, with Personio as the leading system, and build reliable reporting for the management team and the advisory board

Wir bauen die größte Boutique Social Content Agentur für Marktführer & Scale-Ups in DACH auf.

Du bist die rechte Hand des Founders. Du springst da rein, wo es brennt – ob Prozesse aufbauen, Kundenbeziehungen stärken, neue Projekte vorantreiben oder das Team koordinieren. Kein Tag sieht gleich aus, und genau das macht die Rolle so spannend.

Content Creator (m/w/d)
description:
Wir sind die MWX Agency die Social-Media-Kanäle von Kunden aus der ästhetischen Medizin und der Beauty-Branche betreut. Gedreht wird bei mir mit dem Smartphone: schnell, nah dran und gemacht für Instagram, TikTok und Meta Ads. Bisher drehe ich selbst. Weil ich aktuell viel verhindert bin, suche ich jemanden in Hamburg, der das übernimmt.

Aufgaben

Was du machst

  • 4-5 feste Drehtage im Monat bei meinen Kunden in Hamburg und Umgebung, auf Wunsch auch mehr
  • Drehen mit dem Smartphone nach Briefing und Shotlist: Reels, kurze Interviews, Behind the Scenes, Produkt- und Behandlungsaufnahmen, Event-Content
  • Eigenständig vor Ort, denn ich bin meist nicht dabei. Am Set bist du mein Auge
  • Übergabe des Rohmaterials am selben oder am nächsten Tag, sauber benannt und sortiert
  • Pflege deiner Aufgabenkarten in Notion: Status, Links, Fristen

Qualifikation

Was du mitbringst

  • Du drehst sicher mit dem Smartphone und hast ein Gespür für Licht, Ton und Bildausschnitt
  • Du kennst Social-Media-Content und weißt, was in den ersten zwei Sekunden passieren muss
  • Ein eigenes aktuelles Smartphone mit guter Kamera. Mikrofon und Licht für einfache Content Creation kann ich zur Not stellen
  • Souveränes, freundliches Auftreten. Du vertrittst mich bei Ärztinnen, Ärzten und Praxisteams
  • Sorgfalt bei sensiblen Inhalten: Bei medizinischen Kunden gelten feste Grenzen, zum Beispiel keine erkennbaren Patienten ohne Einwilligung, keine Vorher-Nachher-Aufnahmen und keine Ergebnisversprechen. Ich erkläre dir das in der Einarbeitung, danach achtest du selbst darauf
  • Zuverlässigkeit: Ein abgesagter Drehtag kostet einen Kundentermin
  • Von Vorteil: Schnitt in CapCut oder vergleichbar, Führerschein, Englisch

Benefits

Was ich dir biete

  • 4-5 feste Drehtage im Monat, planbar mit Vorlauf, optional mehr
  • Feste Pauschale je Drehtag
  • Eine Einarbeitung: Ich zeige dir die Kunden, die Abläufe und die Vorlagen, bevor du allein drehst
  • Klare Briefings und Shotlists, kurze Wege, eine direkte Ansprechperson

So bewirbst du dich
Schick mir zwei bis drei Arbeitsproben, am liebsten Social-Content, den du selbst mit dem Handy gedreht hast. Dazu ein, zwei Sätze, wann du verfügbar bist. Ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht.

title: Data Scientist & ML Engineer - Predictive Analytics & Agentic AI
description:

Data tells stories, and this role is responsible for turning those stories into decisions. title: Senior Social Strategist
UX Copywriter
description:
Who we are:

We're one of Europe's fastest-growing fintech companies – on a mission to create the world's most empowering way to pay.

We launched the product in 2020 and achieved double unicorn status, valued at $2 billion, and since then have taken on more than 6 million customers.

 

Our mission is to become the best way to pay for anything, anywhere and say goodbye to credit costs for everyone. This is huge. Want to join us?

About the role.


We’re looking for a UX copywriter to join our copy team and help bring the Zilch brand to life across every digital customer touchpoint.

Your primary focus will be partnering with Product Design to create clear and intuitive experiences across our app and website. Working closely with product designers, product managers and engineers, you'll contribute to creating customer journeys from discovery through to launch.

You'll also collaborate with teams across the business, including Marketing, Customer Support and Operations, providing specialist copy support wherever it's needed – from SEO content and help articles to customer communications and product launches.

This isn't just about writing functional copy. It's about creating experiences customers understand, trust and enjoy. You'll know when to keep things simple, when to inject personality and how to bring the Zilch tone of voice to life in even the smallest moments.

We're looking for a creative and tactical thinker who understands that great UX copy does more than guide users from A to B. It solves problems, removes friction and creates experiences that feel simple, human and unmistakably Zilch.

Day to day responsibilities.

  • Partner with Product Design to create clear, engaging copy across the app and website, from new features to end-to-end customer journeys.

  • Collaborate with product managers, designers and engineers throughout the product development process, from discovery through to launch.

  • Write and optimise customer-facing content across digital touchpoints, including help articles, FAQs, SEO content and operational communications.

  • Balance customer needs, business goals and regulatory requirements to create content that's clear, helpful and compliant.

  • Use customer insight, data and testing to improve the content and customer journeys.

title: Growth Analyst
description:
📍Location - this role is based in our London office 2 days per week with the remaining 3 days working remotely

Business to Consumer Partnerships is one of the most entrepreneurial teams at Goodlord, and we’re looking for a Growth Analyst to join us!

This role is all about spotting growth opportunities and making them happen. You’ll look at where we can improve broadband and media conversion, unlock the potential of smaller partnerships and build propositions for under-served tenant groups.

You’ll have real ownership from day one, using data, commercial thinking and great relationships to turn ideas into action. As the team grows, there’s a clear opportunity to take ownership of your own product vertical too.

The Opportunity:

  • Use data and insight to identify commercial opportunities and drive improvements in partner conversion and performance.

  • Build and maintain dashboards, forecasting models and trend analysis to give the team clear visibility and support decision-making.

  • Own relationships with smaller partners, identifying, testing and developing new commercial opportunities.

  • Work cross-functionally with Partnerships, Finance, Product and Commercial teams to develop propositions and improve the tenant journey.

What we need from you:

  • Experience in a commercial, partnerships, analytics or growth-focused role, with a strong track record of spotting and pursuing opportunities.

  • A natural relationship-builder who is confident working with external partners, presenting insights and challenging internal stakeholders.

  • Highly organised and proactive, with the drive to take ownership, turn ideas into action and see them through to completion.

  • Strong data and Excel/Google Sheets skills, with the ability to build models and dashboards and turn insights into clear commercial recommendations.

It would also be great if:

  • You have an interest in the tenant experience, renting or PropTech.

  • You’ve worked in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

  • You’re confident presenting commercial ideas and backing up your thinking.

  • You have experience with SQL or BI tools.

Authority développe de l’intelligence sectorielle, des prévisions et des contenus fondés sur l’expertise afin d’aider les organisations à prendre de meilleures décisions stratégiques.

title: Senior Integrity Engineer
description:
Senior Integrity Engineer

Europe | Remote (hybrid near an Intero office) | 32-40 hours

An inspection shows a client what is wrong. You show them what to do about it.

Are you the integrity engineer people turn to when the inspection data is in and a decision has to be made? Do you enjoy combining fracture mechanics, corrosion growth and sound engineering judgment into advice an operator can actually act on? Then we would like to meet you. We are growing our Integrity team and are looking for our first Senior Integrity Engineer based in Europe.

About Intero

Intero Integrity Services helps pipeline operators and industrial companies keep their assets safe, compliant and running. With our own in-line inspection technology (including MFL and UT) we inspect pipelines and installations all over the world and tell clients exactly what condition their assets are in. Headquartered in Tricht, the Netherlands, we have over 40 years of experience and 650+ professionals from 25+ nationalities.
Learn more about our Inspection service line in this video: Intero - The Power of Integrity.

Your team

You join a close-knit Integrity team of five, including you: a Principal Integrity Engineer and Team Lead in Vancouver, an Integrity Engineer in Mexico City and two Junior Integrity Engineers in Toronto and Calgary. The team is part of our Data Analysis (DA) department.

Together the team delivers integrity reports for clients around the globe. You will be in daily contact with your teammates. The atmosphere is informal, communication is clear and transparent, and the pace follows the workload: some weeks are calm, others are full on. As the first team member in Europe, you strengthen our coverage of European time zones and clients.

Why this role matters

An inspection delivers a list of findings. For our clients, especially in highly regulated markets, a list of problems without a solution is not enough. That is where you come in. The Integrity team turns inspection results into a complete solution package: assessments, remaining life, and clear recommendations that help operators make well-founded decisions about the continued operation of their systems. In this role you raise the quality and consistency of that package, review the work of junior engineers, and help develop the tools and methods the team relies on.

What your week looks like

Part of your week goes to performing integrity assessments on pipelines, piping, heaters and boilers. The other part goes to supporting business development, developing methods and giving technical support. From day one you will work on Corrosion Growth (CG) reports and Fitness-for-Service (FFS) assessments.

title: Business Development Partner
description:

ProcJet Ltd | United Kingdom | Remote | Flexible

ProcJet Ltd is a UK-based industrial procurement and supply chain company supporting the energy, oil & gas, utilities, EPC and infrastructure sectors.

We specialise in UK and European equipment sourcing, industrial materials, OEM and obsolete spare parts, specialist equipment supply and project procurement support.

We are seeking an experienced Business Development Partner to help expand our UK customer base and generate new commercial opportunities.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a commercially driven professional who can use their existing industry network to introduce ProcJet to potential customers and help convert genuine opportunities into business.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Identifying new customers and procurement opportunities within UK industrial and energy sectors.

  • Leveraging existing relationships with operators, EPC contractors, engineering companies and procurement teams.

  • Introducing ProcJet to key decision-makers and arranging client meetings.

  • Identifying live RFQs, equipment requirements and project opportunities.

  • Supporting commercial discussions and converting enquiries into orders.

  • Developing long-term customer relationships and repeat business.

Who We Are Looking For

  • Proven business development or commercial experience in energy, oil & gas, utilities, EPC or industrial supply.

  • An established UK industry network with access to relevant decision-makers.

title: Senior Sourcing Specialist
description:
Join the Wingtra team and become part of this venture-backed robotics scaleup with a global and international team of 125+ dedicated Wingtranauts who want to see their actions have a positive and lasting impact on the world. Founded more than 8 years ago at ETH Zurich, Europe’s leading robotics university, our goal is to build the best aerial robots to digitize the world at the push of a button and set the basis for faster and better decisions. Wingtra provides efficient and reliable data solutions to a variety of industries ranging from mining, construction and agriculture to humanitarian organizations, environmentalists and wildlife monitoring groups.

description:
Über FLOWZOOM

Wir sind FLOWZOOM – eine Marke für hochwertige, innovative Reiseprodukte. Unser Fokus liegt auf Reisekissen, die Komfort, Funktionalität und ansprechendes Design verbinden. Seit 2018 sind wir auf Amazon zu Hause, jetzt bauen wir TikTok Shop Deutschland von Grund auf neu auf. Ihr besonderes Design macht unsere Reisekissen ideal für Short-Form-Videos mit Wow-Effekt: In wenigen Sekunden sieht man, was sie können.

Deine Mission

Der kreative Part gehört dir. Du machst aus unserem Rohmaterial Creatives, die hängen bleiben, drehst selbst Short-Form-Videos und sorgst dafür, dass unser Brand Account Woche für Woche konstant postet. Das Ziel ist einfach: unseren Brand-Kanal mit starken, auf TikTok Shop optimierten Videos füllen. Zuschauer sollen kaufen und Creator sehen, welche Angles funktionieren und sich davon inspirieren lassen. Du entscheidest, wie FLOWZOOM auf TikTok aussieht und klingt und arbeitest eng mit unserem TikTok Shop Lead zusammen, der Kanalstrategie und Produktkatalog verantwortet.

Deine Aufgaben

Creative Creation

  • Du schneidest Short-Form-Videos aus unserem bestehenden Rohmaterial, aus Material vom Team und aus deinem eigenen Footage (neue Hooks, neue Cuts, TikTok-Style)

  • Du bereitest die besten Videos gemeinsam mit dem Social-Media-Team für Instagram und Facebook auf

Content-Analyse

  • Du prüfst wöchentlich wie die Videos performt haben und verstehst warum (Hook, Format, CTA und Länge dokumentieren)

  • Du hältst unsere Video-Bibliothek in Ordnung und dokumentierst systematisch Nutzungsrechte

Support im Creator Management

  • Du unterstützt bei Outreach, Onboarding und Aktivierung unserer TikTok-Shop-Affiliate-Creator – zum Beispiel, indem du Briefings verbesserst oder inaktiven Creatorn Beispielvideos schickst

Der Content, den wir im Kopf haben

Ein Startpunkt, den du mitgestaltest:

  • Du testest einen Mix aus Formaten: Videos mit dir vor der Kamera, faceless Content (POV, Voiceover, Produkt in Action) sowie Clips von Team und Creatorn

  • Du filterst wiederkehrende Formate heraus: ein paar Serien, die unsere Zuschauer wiedererkennen und für die sie zurückkommen, z. B. „A vs. B"

  • Authentische Travel- und Lifestyle-Momente: das Kissen im echten Leben (Flughafen, Flugzeug, Zug, Roadtrip) – kein reiner Verkaufs-Content
